summary: One record per adverse event per subject. Map DM first, code terms with MedDRA, and remember: an event recorded as serious needs its seriousness criteria too.

AETERM.tip: The reported event term exactly as written on the CRF. Required.

AEDECOD.tip: MedDRA preferred term from your coding output. Required: every AE must be coded before submission.

AESER.tip: "Y" or "N" (NY codelist). When "Y", at least one of AESDTH, AESHOSP, AESLIFE, AESDISAB, AESCONG or AESMIE should be "Y".

AEREL.tip: Causality as collected, e.g. "RELATED" / "NOT RELATED" or your CRF's scale. Use one consistent set of values.

AEACN.tip: Action taken with study treatment from the ACN codelist, e.g. "DOSE NOT CHANGED", "DRUG WITHDRAWN".

AEOUT.tip: Outcome from the OUT codelist, e.g. "RECOVERED/RESOLVED", "NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED", "FATAL".

AESEV.tip: "MILD", "MODERATE" or "SEVERE" (AESEV codelist). If you grade with CTCAE, use AETOXGR instead or as well.

AESDTH.tip: "Y" if the event resulted in death. Then DM.DTHFL should be "Y" too.

AESHOSP.tip: "Y" if the event required or prolonged hospitalisation.

AECONTRT.tip: "Y" or "N": was a concomitant treatment given for the event? Those treatments go in CM.

AEENRTPT.tip: Use "ONGOING" (with AEENTPT) for events still ongoing at the end of the study, instead of an end date.
